themes.name: Critical materials and geopolitics
themes.what: The US side of the trade truce is now on paper: a Federal Register document (2026-22793) extends the pause of the export control Affiliates Rule, due to end Nov 9, through Jan 10, 2027, with publication due Monday Nov 9. China's Announcement No. 70 still suspends its October 2025 rare earth rules only until Nov 10, and Beijing had published nothing to extend it as of Nov 7; its Sept 28 statement extending the wider trade arrangement named no rare earth rule (Nov 7 analysis, RawMaterials.net).
themes.for_you: No action before Tuesday. If China lets the pause lapse, MP and USAR get a policy tailwind; neither is a setup and MP is rated Avoid. A last minute Chinese extension to Jan 10 is the most likely outcome.

innovations.name: Agriculture and Food
innovations.what: Rechecked on the daily rotation. Beyond Meat's Q3 revenue fell 8.1% to $64.5 million and its Q4 guide midpoint of $56.5 million is lower again (SEC 8-K, Nov 4). CF's Q3 urea price averaged $423 a ton against $593 in Q2, as buyers priced Gulf supply coming back (CF 10-Q), which weakens the near term cost case for nitrogen-fixing microbes; the weekend Gulf strikes could reverse that. Novonesis grew 6% organically in Q3 and kept its 7% to 8% year guide. No Mexico or Japan approval for the PRRS-resistant pig was found. Deere reports Nov 25. No stage moves.
innovations.for_you: No action. CF (119.39 on Nov 6) is in its zone but rated 'Buy zone, wait for the chart' because sellers outweigh buyers; it needs up/down volume back over 1.0 before any put. BYND is rated Avoid. Mark Nov 11 for Corteva's first crop protection only report and Nov 25 for Deere.

innovations.name: Space
innovations.what: The Nov 8 planning date for Starship Flight 15 passed without a launch; a window is now listed for Friday Nov 13, 5:45pm to 7:00pm EST, pending regulatory approval, with Ship 42 and Booster 22 trying to catch both stages (Space Launch Schedule, updated Nov 7; a Nov 8 newsletter citing SpaceX and SpaceNews). No stage move until a catch succeeds.
innovations.for_you: No action. SPCX has no buy verdict and RKLB (53.07, Avoid) reports Monday; no puts on space names into a launch and two reports. Left out of both lists: a date is not a result.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: Over the weekend the US struck Qeshm Island again (Trump called them 'minor strikes'), launched Task Force Iron Gate to target Iran's land routes and the Caspian Sea, and disabled the cargo ship M/V Huda; Iran lifted its 1,200 mile missile range limit, and on Nov 8 debris from an intercepted rocket caused minor damage to an Aramco building in Riyadh, with no casualties (CBS News live updates). Oil had not traded on this as of Sunday morning.
countries.for_you: No action before oil reopens at 6pm ET Sunday. No energy setups exist to buy a gap, and DAL (87.20 on Nov 6) is the first name to give back last week's fuel gain if oil jumps.
